name: Legacy App
brief: An ordinary extension made headless inside, with Bifröst message types as its public API
description: Deliberately ordinary stock-reservation logic, written as if Bifröst didn't exist and then retrofitted: the business logic lives in an internal headless core, and the app's public API is its Legacy.Stock.* message types. Shows what retrofitting an existing solution actually involves - including the one case that can't be wrapped without touching the app's code.
